restaurantName: Yong Zhou Ji Bian Rou (Jinrong South Road)
address: 10-10 Jinrong South Road, Cangshan, Fuzhou, China Mainland
bio: Despite a very low-key ambiance, this shop in a residential neighbourhood has built a loyal following courtesy of its mini wontons called bian rou, made fresh daily in-house. Bouncy pork filling is enrobed in a translucent, wafer-thin wrapper made with starch and ground pork, served in umami-laden pork bone broth. On top of that, order blanched noodles tossed in sauces, soy-marinated egg, or blanched pork with tendon attached that boasts springy texture....
pageTitle: Yong Zhou Ji Bian Rou (Jinrong South Road)
